# A workspace of two members: json, and app that depends on it. The root narra.toml has no
# [package], so a document's package is the member directory.
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"capabilities":{}}}
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"textDocument/didOpen","params":{"textDocument":{"uri":"file://$ROOT/app/src/main.nra","languageId":"narra","version":1,"text":"import { parse } from \"json/parse\"\n\nexport function run(arguments: Array<string>): int {\n  return parse()\n}\n"}}}
# json changes its signature: json and app are both checked; app's list holds its own file only
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"textDocument/didOpen","params":{"textDocument":{"uri":"file://$ROOT/json/src/parse.nra","languageId":"narra","version":1,"text":"export function parse(): string {\n  return \"x\"\n}\n"}}}
# json gets its own error
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"textDocument/didChange","params":{"textDocument":{"uri":"file://$ROOT/json/src/parse.nra","version":2},"contentChanges":[{"text":"export function parse(): string {\n  return 1\n}\n"}]}}
# an edit in app does not publish json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"textDocument/didChange","params":{"textDocument":{"uri":"file://$ROOT/app/src/main.nra","version":2},"contentChanges":[{"text":"import { parse } from \"json/parse\"\n\nexport function run(arguments: Array<string>): int {\n  return parse() + 0\n}\n"}]}}
# definition of parse from app opens the file in json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"textDocument/definition","params":{"textDocument":{"uri":"file://$ROOT/app/src/main.nra"},"position":{"line":3,"character":11}}}
# a syntax error in json is published on json only, not on a path below app
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"textDocument/didChange","params":{"textDocument":{"uri":"file://$ROOT/json/src/parse.nra","version":3},"contentChanges":[{"text":"export function parse(): string {\n  return (\n}\n"}]}}
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":3,"method":"shutdown"}
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"exit"}
